core_mean_policy.registration: Each member basin plus tapered anomaly on actual geographic coordinates before averaging; no route shift

source_note: Fresh hourly computation using nine exact causal NOAA GFS analyses and the latest available JMA analysis. The run time is separate from the observed initialization. Equal-weight mean of 50 distinct seeded input-perturbed forecasts, not latent samples or deterministic duplicates. Actual common-grid model basin pressure; native detail unavailable and masked. No future weather or official forecast route is an input. Experimental transfer; research only.
pressure_note: Mean of 50 member central-pressure readouts, not the minimum of the mean map. The displayed physical map is each member basin plus geographically registered moving anomaly, averaged on a common grid.
